stem: Albuterol is used to prevent and treat which cluster of respiratory symptoms?

options.label: A
options.text: Only warfarin–vitamin K food counseling visits
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.misconception: Micro distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Wheeze, dyspnea, and chest tightness in asthma or COPD
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: difficulty breathing/wheezing/chest tightness in asthma/COPD.

options.label: D
options.text: Only absolute risk calculations in a cohort study
options.misconception: Epi distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Only lipid A neutralization assays in vitro

options.explanation: Wrong indication; see the cited source passage for detail.
